change.description: Use Docker-reported image-exclusive bytes for cleanup estimates, version persisted estimate semantics, and group confirmation candidates by resource type.
change.release_unit_description: Dockrev cleanup scan API and persisted cleanup inventory snapshot contract.

planned.reasoning: The API adds an optional estimateBasis response field. Persisted snapshots add an estimate version and preserve legacy reads by treating old image estimates as unknown and rescanning; no destructive migration is introduced.
evidence: C4: estimateBasis is optional and missing snapshot version defaults to 0

scope_drift.description: No new public API or persistent-state surface beyond the planned optional estimate basis and estimate version.

current.reasoning: Existing API fields and requests remain unchanged. New snapshot fields are additive; the candidate reads pre-version snapshots and fails closed for their stale image estimates.
evidence: crates/dockrev-api/src/api/types/cleanup.rs: estimate_basis is optional and estimate_version defaults to 0

verified.reasoning: Compatibility tests verify optional response metadata, current snapshot versioning, and safe handling of legacy snapshots. Release version selection and publication remain deferred to the release process.

public_api.supported_consumer_range: Existing cleanup API consumers; estimateBasis is optional and request/apply fields are unchanged.
evidence: docs/specs/qynjg-docker-prune-cleanup-console/contracts/http-apis.md: older clients may omit or ignore estimateBasis

persistent_state.state_description: JSON cleanup inventory snapshots persisted under the cleanup inventory snapshot key.
persistent_state.source_program_compatibility_range: The candidate reads snapshots from earlier versions with no estimateVersion. Earlier readers ignore additive JSON fields by default; release-specific support bounds will be confirmed during Release Preparation.

calculation_evidence: release version and channel selection are deferred until after PR merge
